worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of $\text{arccot}$ is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\text{arccot }x)=-\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\text{arccot }x+\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+1)) \\  & =-\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}+\frac{2x}{{x}^{2}+1} \\  & =\frac{2x-1}{{x}^{2}+1}.\end{aligned}
$$
